title: REQ · Boy portrait grid is 32x32 and palette-only
summary: 32x32 portrait source for the dialogue card
description: Context: dialogue card needs a boy portrait. Desired behavior: boy.ts exports BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE, one 32x32 frame with outline and ramp shading. Expected result: size and palette checkable. Why: SG-2.2 done-when.
acceptance_criteria: Given BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE, when frames.length is read, then it equals 1
